sentence_patterns.pattern: TU YOUYOU AWARDED NOBEL PRIZE
sentence_patterns.explain: 新闻标题的写作特点，包括用词精准、主题明确、简明扼要，以及全大写和首字母大写等格式。
sentence_patterns.example: TU YOUYOU AWARDED NOBEL PRIZE
sentence_patterns.translation: 屠呦呦获诺贝尔奖

sentence_patterns.pattern: In 1967, the Chinese government formed a team of scientists with the objective of discovering a new treatment for malaria, and Tu Youyou was among the first researchers chosen.
sentence_patterns.explain: 并列复合句，介词短语作状语，过去分词作定语。
sentence_patterns.example: In 1967, the Chinese government formed a team of scientists with the objective of discovering a new treatment for malaria, and Tu Youyou was among the first researchers chosen.
sentence_patterns.translation: 1967年，中国政府组建了一支以探索治疗疟疾新方法为目的的科学家队伍，屠呦呦是其中首批入选的研究人员。

sentence_patterns.pattern: One medical text from the fourth century suggested using the extract from sweet wormwood to treat a fever.
sentence_patterns.explain: 简单句，使用过去时态。
sentence_patterns.example: One medical text from the fourth century suggested using the extract from sweet wormwood to treat a fever.
sentence_patterns.translation: 一本四世纪的医药文献推荐使用青蒿提取物来治疗发烧。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Upon hearing that she had been awarded the Nobel Prize, …
sentence_patterns.explain: 介词短语作时间状语，表示某事发生的时间。
sentence_patterns.example: Upon hearing that she had been awarded the Nobel Prize, …
sentence_patterns.translation: 当听到自己被授予诺贝尔奖时，⋯⋯

sentence_patterns.pattern: He had a thick moustache and long white hair, which sometimes stood on end as though he had just received an electric shock.
sentence_patterns.explain: 定语从句，使用过去分词作定语。
sentence_patterns.example: He had a thick moustache and long white hair, which sometimes stood on end as though he had just received an electric shock.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他胡须浓密，头发又长又白，有时会像刚遭了电击似的竖起来。

sentence_patterns.pattern: In the future, we will be using advanced technology every day for automatic control of just about everything in our home.
sentence_patterns.explain: 将来时态，使用现在进行时表示将来，用于描述习惯性的动作或经常发生的事情。
sentence_patterns.example: You’ve met just about everyone.
sentence_patterns.translation: 你几乎每个人都见到了。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Your lights will come on the instant you enter the door along with your favourite music or TV programmes, and you will find your dinner already prepared for you.
sentence_patterns.explain: the instant (that) 作为连词，引导时间状语从句，表示一...就...。
sentence_patterns.example: I recognised her the instant (= as soon as) I saw her.
sentence_patterns.translation: 我一眼就认出她了。

sentence_patterns.pattern: The instant he ﬁnished transferring the payment, he started having second thoughts.
sentence_patterns.explain: the instant (that) 作为连词，引导时间状语从句，表示一...就...。
sentence_patterns.example: He said he’d phone you the moment he got home.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他说他一到家就给你打电话。

sentence_patterns.pattern: instant单独作名词时，表示“瞬间；片刻”，相当于moment。
sentence_patterns.explain: instant 作为名词，表示瞬间或片刻。
sentence_patterns.example: I’ll be back in an instant.
sentence_patterns.translation: 我马上就回来。

sentence_patterns.pattern: For example, if a water pipe starts leaking, or if there is a short in the electrical wiring, your smart home will detect it and provide you with the relevant information.
sentence_patterns.explain: if 引导条件状语从句，表示如果。
sentence_patterns.example: The fire was caused by a short in the neighbour’s house.
sentence_patterns.translation: 这次火灾是由邻居家的电线短路引起的。

sentence_patterns.pattern: I wake up to the sound of the wind buffeting the cloth of my tent.
sentence_patterns.explain: wake up to 意为因为听到某种声音而醒来，也可指意识到或认识到。buffet 作动词指风势猛烈地拍打。
sentence_patterns.example: The rain buffeted the window. I couldn’t fall asleep at all.
sentence_patterns.translation: 大雨拍打着窗户，我根本无法入睡。

sentence_patterns.pattern: I’m in the remote far north of Sweden in Sarek National Park, a place with no roads or towns.
sentence_patterns.explain: in the remote far north of 指在偏远且遥远的北方。a place with no roads or towns 指一个没有公路和城镇的地方。
sentence_patterns.example: Sarek National Park, located in the remote far north of Sweden, is one of the oldest national parks in Europe.
sentence_patterns.translation: 萨勒克国家公园位于瑞典偏远的北方，是欧洲最古老的国家公园之一。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Following the reindeer were the Sami people, who made this territory their home.
sentence_patterns.explain: Following the reindeer 是主谓语倒装，主语 the Sami people 后置，以便与后面的定语从句更好地衔接。
sentence_patterns.example: People were following the reindeer. They were the Sami people and they made this territory their home.
sentence_patterns.translation: 人们跟随着驯鹿。他们是萨米人，他们在这片土地上安家落户。

sentence_patterns.pattern: If today is anything like yesterday, it will be full of sweat and hard work as I hike over this difficult land to my destination on the other side of the valley.
sentence_patterns.explain: anything like 意为与……相像；多少有点像。
sentence_patterns.example: He isn’t anything like his twin sister. He is very outgoing and talkative.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他和他双胞胎姐姐（或妹妹）可不太像。他特别外向而且健谈。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Theme Park
sentence_patterns.explain: 主题公园提供的各种活动都和主题互相关联，主题包罗万象，如星际旅行、历史传奇、民俗文化等。
sentence_patterns.example: Disneyland, also known as Disney theme park, is the world's first theme park.
sentence_patterns.translation: 迪士尼乐园，也称为迪士尼主题公园，是世界上最早开业的主题公园。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Whichever and whatever you like, there is an incredible theme park that will appeal to you!
sentence_patterns.explain: whichever 意为任何一个；无论哪个；无论哪些。appeal to 意为吸引；对……有感染力。
sentence_patterns.example: You can use whichever colour you like.
sentence_patterns.translation: 你可以用任何一种颜色。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Many students are quite shy and don’t speak all that much.
sentence_patterns.explain: not (all) that + 形容词或副词，口语化表达。
sentence_patterns.example: Many students are quite shy and don’t speak all that much.
sentence_patterns.translation: 许多学生生性腼腆，沉默寡言。

sentence_patterns.pattern: what makes each student tick?
sentence_patterns.explain: what makes somebody tick，指影响某人性格或行为的原因。
sentence_patterns.example: what makes each student tick?
sentence_patterns.translation: 我是如何搞清楚每个学生为何会这样的呢？

sentence_patterns.pattern: It is as though they are asleep with their eyes open.
sentence_patterns.explain: It’s as though ...相当于as if，意为“就像；好比”。
sentence_patterns.example: It is as though they are asleep with their eyes open.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他们的眼睛几乎不动，脸上表情疏远呆滞，好像睁着眼睛在睡觉。

sentence_patterns.pattern: While it is easy to perceive when students are interested, bored, or distracted, it is sometimes much harder to distinguish when students are troubled.
sentence_patterns.explain: while表示让步关系，意为“虽然；尽管”。
sentence_patterns.example: While it is easy to perceive when students are interested, bored, or distracted, it is sometimes much harder to distinguish when students are troubled.
sentence_patterns.translation: 尽管学生们何时（对讲课）感兴趣、何时感到无聊或精力不集中是容易察觉的，但要发现学生何时有困扰有时会难得多。

sentence_patterns.pattern: However, if a student does not bother to brush her hair and her eyes are red from weeping, then I can infer that there are deeper issues at work.
sentence_patterns.explain: bother to do，费心做某事；at work，起着特定影响或作用。
sentence_patterns.example: However, if a student does not bother to brush her hair and her eyes are red from weeping, then I can infer that there are deeper issues at work.
sentence_patterns.translation: 但是，要是学生都懒得梳头，并且两眼因哭泣而发红，那么我能够推断她遇到了更严重的问题。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Indeed, his slim but strong body was just like that of millions of Chinese farmers, to whom he had devoted his life.
sentence_patterns.explain: devote ... to 是个动词短语，表示“把（时间、精力或注意力）投入，用于”，也可以搭配反身代词 devote oneself to，表示“致力于；专心于”，注意这里to用作介词。
sentence_patterns.example: She decided to quit her job and devote more time to painting.
sentence_patterns.translation: 她决定辞掉工作，把更多的时间用在画画上。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Yuan Longping realised that larger fields were not the solution. Instead, farmers needed to boost yields in the fields they had.
sentence_patterns.explain: yield在句中作名词，表示“产量；收益”。如：high yield高产 low yield低产。yield还可以作动词，除了表示“生产；产出”之外，还可以表示“屈服；放弃”之意。
sentence_patterns.example: The fruit trees in his orchards yield a large amount of apples and pears every year.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他果园的果树每年产出大量的苹果和梨。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Today, it is estimated that about 60 percent of domestic rice consumption in China is comprised of crops generated from Yuan’s hybrid strains, and his strains have allowed China’s farmers to produce around 200 million tons of rice per year.
sentence_patterns.explain: 这个句子的真正主语是从句that about 60 ... per year。因为真正的主语太长，为了避免句子头重脚轻，所以用形式主语it。英语中还有许多类似It is estimated that ... 这样的结构，用来将真正主语后置。
sentence_patterns.example: It is said/believed/reported that ...
sentence_patterns.translation: 据说/相信/报道说...

sentence_patterns.pattern: Given that Yuan’s hybrids made him quite wealthy, one might think he would have retired to a life of leisure. However, this is far from the case.
sentence_patterns.explain: given that在句中作连词，意思是“考虑到”。如：Given that the students need more exercise, the head teacher has decided to add more PE classes. Given可用作介词，表示“只要是；考虑到；假定；已知”等意思。
sentence_patterns.example: Given his age, he is very strong and healthy.
sentence_patterns.translation: 考虑到他的年龄，他可以说是非常健康强壮了。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Deep down, Yuan was still very much a farmer at heart.
sentence_patterns.explain: deep down表示“实际上；在心底”的意思。如：He tried to behave as an adult, but deep down he was still a child. very much 副词短语，表示“非常；确实是”。在文中表示程度，起强调作用，可以不用翻译出来。
sentence_patterns.example: He tried to behave as an adult, but deep down he was still a child.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他试图表现得像一个大人，但是内心深处他还是一个孩子。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Organic farming is nowhere near able to meet that need.
sentence_patterns.explain: nowhere near在句中是“完全没有；远不及”的意思。如：He is nowhere near full recovery. nowhere作名词是“无处；任何地方；无名之地”的意思，例如表达身处偏僻荒凉的地方，可以说in the middle of nowhere。如：She came out of nowhere. nowhere作副词是“无处；任何地方都不”的意思。
sentence_patterns.example: He is going nowhere.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他哪儿也不去。
